resources.string: Experimental manual controller for the existing vendor Dolby effect. Hardware audio quality, routing and persistence are unverified. Changes may not survive closing this screen, route changes or reboot. No settings are restored automatically.
Not connected. Tap Inspect to query the vendor effect. Opening this screen does not change settings.
Names for IDs 0–8 come from the stock factory XML, not live labels. Other IDs are shown numerically. Runtime profile availability and behavior still require a device test.
Readback: Dolby %1$s · framework effect %2$s\nCurrent profile: %3$s · profile count: %4$d\nThis reports current effect state, not audible output or persistence.
Effect unavailable or operation unconfirmed: %1$s\nAn attempted change may have partially applied. Controls are disabled; tap Inspect to read the actual state.
